definition_en: the father of one of your parents, or a male ancestor
core_image: 老爷爷坐在藤椅上，给孙子讲从前的故事
scene: 老爷爷坐在藤椅上，给孙子讲从前的故事。My grandfather tells good stories.

senses.whyCN: 因为祖父本身就是上一代，复数 grandfathers 可以指更早的男性先祖。

senses.definition: the threads growing on a person's head
senses.example: She has long black hair.
senses.why: Old English hær named the fine threads on the head; the word is Germanic and also covered an animal's coat.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 hær 指头上细密的丝状物；这个词属日耳曼语，也兼指动物的毛。

senses.title: The coat of an animal or body
senses.definition: the coat of an animal or body
senses.example: The dog left hair on the sofa.
senses.why: Because the same threads grow on animals, hair names an animal's coat as well as human head hair.
senses.whyCN: 因为同样的细丝也长在动物身上，hair 兼指人的头发与动物的毛。

senses.title: A very small amount
senses.definition: a very small amount
senses.example: The rope missed the rock by a hair.
senses.exampleCN: 绳子差一丝就撞上岩石。
senses.why: The width of a hair is tiny, so English uses it for a very small margin, as in by a hair.
senses.whyCN: 一根头发极细，英语就用它表示极小的差距，如 by a hair。
